title: US CPI rises 0.5% in June, above the 0.3% consensus
body: Headline consumer prices rose 0.5% on the month and 3.4% on the year, both above forecasts; core also beat.

title: US CPI rises 0.1% in June, below the 0.3% consensus
body: Headline consumer prices rose 0.1% on the month and 2.6% on the year, both below forecasts; core also missed.

title: Payrolls jump 290k in July, far above the 160k forecast
body: Non-farm payrolls increased by 290,000 and the unemployment rate fell to 3.8%; wages accelerated.

title: Payrolls add just 40k in July, far below the 160k forecast
body: Non-farm payrolls increased by 40,000 and the unemployment rate rose to 4.4%; prior months revised down.

title: Fed holds rates and signals further hikes may be needed
body: The committee kept the target range unchanged and said additional firming could be appropriate; dots moved higher.

title: Fed holds rates and signals cuts are coming
body: The committee kept the target range unchanged and said it expects to begin easing soon; dots moved lower.

title: Dollar index surges 1.2% to a six-month high
body: The greenback rallied against every major currency as yields climbed; the index broke above its recent range.

title: Dollar index slides 1.2% to a six-month low
body: The greenback fell against every major currency as yields dropped; the index broke below its recent range.

title: Core PCE accelerates to 0.4% m/m, hotter than expected
body: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge rose 0.4% in May against a 0.2% consensus; the annual rate ticked up.

title: Core PCE slows to 0.1% m/m, cooler than expected
body: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge rose 0.1% in May against a 0.2% consensus; the annual rate eased.

title: US GDP grows 3.9% annualised in Q3, beating forecasts
body: Third-quarter output expanded at a 3.9% pace versus the 2.5% consensus, led by consumer spending.

title: US GDP grows 0.8% annualised in Q3, missing forecasts
body: Third-quarter output expanded at a 0.8% pace versus the 2.5% consensus as consumer spending stalled.

title: Gold ETFs record largest weekly inflow of the year
body: Physically backed gold funds added 42 tonnes last week, the biggest weekly inflow since January.

title: Gold ETFs record largest weekly outflow of the year
body: Physically backed gold funds shed 42 tonnes last week, the biggest weekly outflow since January.

title: Initial jobless claims jump to 265k, highest since 2024
body: New claims for unemployment benefits rose by 30,000 to 265,000, well above the 230,000 consensus.

title: Initial jobless claims fall to 195k, lowest since 2024
body: New claims for unemployment benefits dropped by 30,000 to 195,000, well below the 230,000 consensus.

title: Ten tips for a tidier home office
body: Decluttering your desk can improve focus, according to productivity coaches.

title: Local football club signs new striker on three-year deal
body: The forward joins from a rival side after scoring 22 goals last season.

title: Review: the new mid-range phone gets most things right
body: Battery life is excellent and the camera is competitive for the price.

title: City council approves new bicycle lanes downtown
body: Construction on the protected lanes begins in the summer and should finish by autumn.

title: Recipe: a weeknight lentil soup in thirty minutes
body: Cumin, garlic and a squeeze of lemon make this simple soup memorable.

title: Museum extends opening hours for summer exhibition
body: The show of landscape paintings has drawn record visitor numbers.

title: Streaming service announces second season of fantasy drama
body: Production begins next month with the main cast returning.

title: How to keep houseplants alive while on holiday
body: Self-watering spikes and a shaded spot go a long way.

title: Marathon route changed to avoid roadworks
body: Organisers said the new course is slightly flatter than last year's.

title: Board game night ideas for large groups
body: Party games with simple rules keep everyone involved.

title: CPI beats on headline but core inflation misses
body: Headline prices rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected while core rose only 0.1% versus 0.3%; the mix leaves the rate path open.

title: Payrolls beat but unemployment rate rises and wages slow
body: Employers added 210,000 jobs against 170,000 expected, yet the jobless rate rose to 4.3% and hourly earnings cooled.

title: Fed chair says the committee is 'in no hurry' in either direction
body: In the press conference the chair repeated that policy could move either way depending on the data.

title: Ceasefire talks resume but both sides report new strikes overnight
body: Negotiators met for a third round while fighting continued in several regions; the outcome is uncertain.

title: Dollar flat as yields rise but equities rally
body: Mixed cross-asset signals left the dollar index unchanged on the day after a volatile session.

title: Central bank gold buying slows but retail bar demand surges
body: Official-sector purchases fell to the lowest in two years while bar and coin demand in Asia hit a record.

title: Missile strikes reported near major oil shipping lane
body: Several tankers diverted after explosions were reported; oil jumped 4% and safe-haven assets rose.

title: Border clashes escalate between two nuclear-armed neighbours
body: Artillery exchanges intensified overnight; both governments put forces on alert.

title: Peace agreement signed, ending a two-year regional conflict
body: Leaders signed the accord in the capital; markets unwound haven positions.

title: Trade talks between the two largest economies end without a deal
body: Officials said negotiations would continue next quarter; tariff deadlines remain in place.

title: Producer prices unexpectedly fall 0.2% in February
body: Wholesale inflation declined for the first time in a year on cheaper energy and goods.

title: Consumer inflation expectations rise to 3.6% in sentiment survey
body: The one-year expectations gauge climbed from 3.1%; the five-year measure was unchanged.

title: Fed governor says policy is 'well positioned' to wait
body: In a speech the governor saw no urgency to change rates and described risks as balanced.

title: Regional Fed president calls for a rate cut at the next meeting
body: The president said inflation progress justified easing and that waiting risked the labour market.

title: Fed minutes show several officials favoured a larger hike
body: Minutes of the last meeting revealed a more hawkish debate than the statement suggested.

title: Unemployment rate rises to 4.6%, highest in three years
body: The jobless rate climbed for the third straight month as hiring slowed across sectors.

title: Job openings fall to lowest level since 2021
body: Vacancies dropped to 7.1 million and the quits rate eased, pointing to a cooling labour market.

title: ISM manufacturing index rebounds to 53.2 from 48.9
body: Factory activity expanded for the first time in six months; new orders and prices paid both rose.

title: Retail sales fall 0.6% in June, weakest in a year
body: Spending dropped across most categories; the control group also missed.

title: Eurozone GDP stagnates in Q4, confirming the preliminary estimate
body: Output was flat on the quarter as expected; the release matched the earlier flash.

title: Chinese GDP growth slows to 4.3% in Q3
body: Output growth eased from 4.8% as property investment fell; policymakers pledged support.

title: Treasury yields spike after weak auction, dollar follows higher
body: The 10-year yield rose 12 basis points as demand for the auction disappointed; the dollar gained broadly.

title: Dollar drifts lower in thin summer trading
body: The index slipped 0.1% with no data on the calendar; volumes were light.

title: Dollar steady ahead of this week's payrolls report
body: Currency markets were quiet as traders awaited Friday's jobs data.

title: Major central bank adds 30 tonnes of gold to reserves in February
body: Official data showed the largest monthly purchase since 2023.

title: Speculators cut net long gold futures positions by a third
body: Weekly positioning data showed the largest reduction in managed-money longs this year.

title: Jewellery demand falls 8% as high prices deter buyers
body: Quarterly demand figures showed weakness in the two largest consumer markets.

title: Gold futures halted briefly after a flash spike in Asian hours
body: Prices jumped 1.5% in seconds on thin liquidity before retracing; the exchange cited no error.

title: Large mining company reports a 10% rise in quarterly gold output
body: Production rose on higher grades at its flagship mine; guidance was maintained.

title: Copper rallies to a record on supply disruption
body: A strike at a major mine lifted copper 5%; other metals were little changed.

title: Explosion reported at a government building in a major capital
body: Emergency services responded to the blast; the cause is not yet known and markets moved to safety.

title: Fed chair: 'the risks to inflation remain to the upside'
body: In testimony the chair said the committee would respond forcefully if inflation re-accelerated.

title: CPI matches expectations at 0.3% m/m
body: Headline and core inflation printed in line with consensus; the annual rate held at 2.9%.

title: Weekly jobless claims in line with forecasts
body: Initial claims were 225,000, matching the consensus; continuing claims were little changed.
